**[6]** "Workers & Sandboxing." *Activepieces Documentation*, n.d.
<https://www.activepieces.com/docs/install/architecture/workers>
**Tier:** 2
Data extracted: Four execution modes — SANDBOX_CODE_ONLY (V8, no npm, fast),
UNSANDBOXED (full Node.js + npm + bash, fast, not multi-tenant safe),
SANDBOX_PROCESS (kernel namespaces, npm, privileged Docker, slow),
SANDBOX_CODE_AND_PROCESS (V8 + process isolation). UNSANDBOXED allows bash
scripts and filesystem access.
